newsitem.title: USA: South Carolina jobless rate steady at 5.9 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: South Carolina jobless rate steady at 5.9 pct in Sept.

text.p: South Carolina's unemployment rate was 5.9 percent in September, unchanged from August, the state Employment Security Commission said Wednesday.
"The unemployment picture will probably remain fairly stable for the next couple of months until hiring for the holiday season begins," said Joel Cassidy, the commission's executive director.
Total nonfarm employment grew by 8,700 over the month, to 1.69 million. Government led the increase for the second consecutive month, as nonfaculty personnel returned to work at schools and colleges.

Manufacturing posted the largest decrease, 1,300 jobs, with losses scattered throughout the industry. Trade and finance lost 800 jobs, while insurance and real estate showed seasonal losses of 600 jobs.
Williamsburg County had the state's highest unemployment rate, 20.3 percent, while Beaufort County had the lowest, 2.9 percent.
